user.title: HOLM Bins
user.description: Collection dates, reminders and animations are then set from the HOLM Bins card (gear icon). You can import your existing collection calendars here: one bin will be created for each.

data.detect_rules: Convert to a recurrence when possible

data_description.import_calendars: One bin per calendar. Leave empty to start from scratch.
data_description.detect_rules: If a calendar's collections are regular (same day, every N weeks), the bin will use a recurrence you can edit from the card instead of the calendar.

check_camera.name: Check bins with the camera
check_camera.description: Takes a picture with the chosen camera and asks the AI task which due bins are visible: those seen are marked out, the others trigger the alert.
